Alumni

Aravind Muralidharan

Class of 2025

Roles

  • Co-Secretary, Ocean Science Bowl Co-Captain

Bio

Senior Aravind Muralidharan serves as ocean science bowl captain and the treasurer for the AC club this year. He has also tried in science bowl, quiz bowl, and science Olympiad with varying degrees of success. His other activities include playing violin for the school orchestra as well as the California Youth Symphony; running for MSJ track and field in the 100 meters, long jump, and triple jump; and grinding for USABO. In his free time he likes to listen to and play classical music, attempt records in MarioKart 8 deluxe, work on jigsaw puzzles (looking for a good 2000 piece puzzle right now), and play street basketball with his friends.

MSJ Academic Challenge
